```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(duckknit)
data_dir = path.expand("~/Scratch/duckdb")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = data_dir)
s = duckknit::duckknit_start_session("notes")
duckknit::duckknit_exec(s, paste0(".cd ", data_dir))
```


# Exercise 1

Using `train_services.parquet`, count the stops per train `type` on 2023-05-20 with `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` and note the columns read, row groups scanned, and data read. Then filter on a single `train_number` instead and compare.

```{duckdb, session='notes'}
EXPLAIN ANALYZE
SELECT type, count(*) AS n
FROM 'train_services.parquet'
WHERE date = '2023-05-20'
GROUP BY ALL;
```

```{duckdb}
EXPLAIN ANALYZE
SELECT type, count(*) AS n
FROM 'train_services.parquet'
WHERE train_number = 1410
GROUP BY ALL;
```

```{duckdb}
SELECT row_group_id, stats_min, stats_max
FROM parquet_metadata('train_services.parquet')
WHERE path_in_schema = 'train_number';
```


# Exercise 2

Using the TPC-H tables, report the average `o_totalprice` by `c_mktsegment` for orders placed in 1995. Use `EXPLAIN` to find the build side of each join and where the date filter ended up, then `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` to find the slowest operator and compare estimates to actual rows.

```{duckdb}
ATTACH 'tpch.duckdb' AS tpch (READ_ONLY);
USE tpch;
```

```{duckdb}
EXPLAIN
SELECT c_mktsegment, round(avg(o_totalprice), 2) AS price
FROM orders JOIN customer ON o_custkey = c_custkey
WHERE o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY price DESC;
```

```{duckdb}
EXPLAIN ANALYZE
SELECT c_mktsegment, round(avg(o_totalprice), 2) AS price
FROM orders JOIN customer ON o_custkey = c_custkey
WHERE o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY price DESC;
```
